_readme: Human-vote leaderboard signal (arena.ai, formerly LMArena/Chatbot Arena) for scripts/derive-signals.mjs's `families` calibration in assets/decide.mjs. Arena's leaderboard tables render client-side via JS — curl gets nav/footer only (verified by diffing curl output against a headless-browser render of the same URL), so this is NOT a live-fetched Collect input like usage.openrouter or this same signals pipeline's OpenRouter task-spend data. It is a DATED, MANUAL snapshot: fetched once via a headless browser (Claude_Browser, read-only) on 2026-09-07 against a page self-dated 'Sep 2, 2026', with the raw captures kept alongside the research batch that built it. `rank` is this model's position within the mapped-to-catalog cut for that task/category (1st mapped = rank 1, etc.) — NOT its raw position on Arena's own (much longer, mostly-unmapped) leaderboard; effort-level variants of the same base model (e.g. claude-opus-5-high / claude-opus-5-max) were de-duplicated to their best-ranked variant before this cut was taken. `category` names the actual Arena leaderboard or column used as each task's proxy — several tasks have no dedicated Arena category and use the closest available one (documented per task below and in eval/signals.md, which is the primary methodology doc this file was distilled from). Refresh procedure: scripts/refresh.md's 'signals refresh' section — replace this file's `tasks` block and bump `as_of`; there is no automated refresh for this source.

bulk.note: Arena measures preference/quality by blind vote, not cost or throughput — no coverage for a cost-defined task. Documented gap, not an oversight (eval/signals.md).

research.category: Overview tab, "Search" top-10 card (grounded web search — closest proxy; Arena has no dedicated research/analysis category)

extraction.note: Only 4 of the top-10 card's entries mapped to a catalog id; the rest were off-catalog/older SKUs.

exec-summaries.category: Text-Arena rank matrix, "Longer Query" column (proxy — Arena has no dedicated summarization category)
